overview: Build and critique one saved workflow design for the supplied monthly-review case. Nonempty reflections or step counts do not establish competence.
instructions: Choose an owned saved process submission from this course or the supplied map. Retain its original identity and content; selecting it approves its use for this design attempt, not its competence or a workflow run.

Create or edit one workflow through supported chat/editor controls. Return to the same artifact; inspect its saved tasks, input-source settings, attached inputs and output settings rather than relying on the agent description.

For each necessary operation, name the input, transformation and output. Keep required narrative context available; a prompt over relevant short source text can be valid without a separate extraction. Do not add steps merely to reach a count.

Remove the unapproved destination. End the automated portion at the internal draft, with no send, share or scheduling action. A reviewer responsibility in this exercise does not require a real staff account or an Approval request.
Retain source/intermediate references, unresolved issues and a defined review or stop path. Explain what the design intends; do not claim its runtime behavior has been tested.

Save corrections before explicitly approving the inspected revision for assessment. A later edit requires a new captured revision and decision; preserve the original. Do not run this design for this module.
